Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer

Class MediaItem

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer.MediaItem
public class MediaItem extends Object
One entry of the audio player's library / playlist: a local file, a network stream, an AM/FM or internet radio station, or a podcast episode. Items are plain Jackson beans persisted by AudioPlayerStore, so the class stays serialisable (no-arg constructor plus getters/setters, no live handles).

location is either an absolute file path or a URL; the MediaItem.Kind records how the entry was added so the UI can show the right glyph and the backend can pick native versus external playback.

    • file

      public static MediaItem file(String path, String name, String artist, String album, int trackNumber, String mbid, String coverFile)
      Builds a tagged MediaItem.Kind.FILE item, e.g. one just ripped from an audio CD with its album metadata resolved from the CD database.
      Parameters:
      path - the absolute file path
      name - the track title (blank falls back to the file name)
      artist - the album artist, may be blank
      album - the album title, may be blank
      trackNumber - the 1-based track number, or 0 when unknown
      mbid - the MusicBrainz release id, may be blank
      coverFile - the cached album-cover image path, may be blank
      Returns:
      the tagged item
